output.one_liner: Salesforce is a cloud-based CRM platform for managing customer relationships, sales, service, and commerce with integrated AI agents.

auth.notes: OAuth 2.0 is the primary authentication method for external client apps and connected apps. External client apps are now preferred over connected apps as of Spring 2026. DPoP (Demonstrating Proof-of-Possession) is optional for enhanced token security.

evidence.snippet: OAuth 2.0 is an open protocol that authorizes secure data sharing between applications through the exchange of tokens.

access.notes: Free Salesforce Developer Edition available at developer.salesforce.com/signup for testing and development. 30-day free trial also available for Salesforce Platform editions.

evidence.snippet: Developer Edition provides a free and easy solution so that you can use Salesforce for testing and development.
To sign up for a Developer Edition account, go to developer.salesforce.com/signup.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: Developer Edition: 15,000 API calls per 24 hours; 5 concurrent requests. Production/Sandboxes: 100,000+ calls per 24 hours; 25 concurrent requests.

buildability.rationale: Free self-serve Developer Edition credentials, well-documented OAuth 2.0 REST and SOAP APIs with broad resource coverage, and existing Composio toolkit with 595 tools confirm immediate buildability.

overview_evidence.snippet: Your agents, your team, your data — working together so every customer interaction reflects your business at its best.
REST API uses RESTful architecture to provide a straightforward and consistent interface without requiring much tooling to access data.
